notes: Catalog combination: THMS600 stage + T96-S controller + LNP96-S LN2 pump + Dewar. Light aperture 2.0 mm diameter (specs page). Objective working distance 4.8 mm; v1.1 datasheet: lid window to element 4.5 mm, condenser (base window) distance 12.5 mm, light aperture 2.4 mm, lid window 0.17 mm - older values superseded by current page (4.8 mm, 2.0 mm, 0.5 mm). Dewar: current electrical product guide lists 'Add LNP96 and 3L Dewar' (https://www.mccrone.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/MMA_Electrical-Stage-Product-Guide-V1.0.pdf); predecessor LNP95 shipped with 2 L Dewar. Window count 2 = lid window (current specs) + base plate window for transmitted light ('isolated from the sample by the stage base plate window', v1.1 datasheet); both on the vertical optical axis. Quick-release gas valves for atmospheric control. Stage is static apart from manual XY manipulators, pumped LN2/nitrogen gas flow through the block, and optional water circulation; no pulse tube, no magnet. Linkam brochure v1.54 (2026) fetched: it carries no body dimensions, only 22 mm sample size, 15 mm XY, 4.8 mm working distance.
